pgc.q07BannerDesc: Table 07 of Model 1 performs the tax adjustment of Net Income for the Period (RLE determined in Account 88 of the PGC). Values recorded in cost accounts (Classes 6 and 7) not accepted tax-wise by the Corporate Tax Code must be added (Positive Variations), while exempt income must be deducted (Negative Variations).

about.title: Accounting and Tax Reconciliation System
about.heroDescription: Developed by SCKJ - COMÉRCIO E SERVIÇOS, (SU), LDA to ensure strict reconciliation between the General Accounting Plan (PGC), the VAT Code (CIVA - Law No. 7/19), and Model 7 tax declarations submitted to the General Tax Administration (AGT).
about.companyBio1: SCKJ is an Angolan company dedicated to accounting consulting, digital tax audit, and software engineering applied to corporate governance.
about.companyBio2: Our purpose is to provide accountants, tax experts, and audit teams with modern solutions eliminating divergences between Class 34 accounts (State and Other Public Entities) and official AGT statutory declarations in Angola.
about.legalComplianceDesc: Full compliance with Law No. 7/19 (CIVA), 6.5% withholding tax, and General Accounting Plan (PGC).
about.exactReconciliationDesc: Automated cross-check between Trial Balances and fields 1 to 61 of the AGT Model 7 declaration.
about.scannerOcrDesc: Optical recognition of supplier invoices from PDF/images with tax QR Code validation and AGT certification check.
about.multiCompanyDesc: Secure multi-tenant environment for accounting firms and corporate groups to manage multiple entities independently.
about.archDesc: Secure, structured processing for continuous tax audit.
about.mod1Desc: Systematic comparison of accounts 34.5.3 (Output VAT), 34.5.2 (Input VAT), and 34.5.5 (Settled VAT) against Model 7 declarations submitted to AGT.
about.mod2Desc: Intelligent invoice digitization, tax data extraction (NIF, items, rates, deductible/non-deductible VAT) and auditable digital archive.
about.mod3Desc: Detailed analysis of 6.5% withholding taxes, reversals, withholdings, credit notes, and executive reports ready for export or print.
about.supportDesc: Direct assistance channels for invoice operators, accountants, and system administrators.
about.techSupportDesc: Software guidance, user creation, document upload troubleshooting, and credential resets.
about.fiscalOfficeDesc: Clarification of accounting divergences, CIVA (Law No. 7/19) rules, and AGT report validation.
about.adminOfficeDesc: Corporate relations, enterprise licensing contracts, and direct contact with SCKJ management.
about.copyright: © 2026 SCKJ - COMÉRCIO E SERVIÇOS, (SU), LDA • NIF: 5002830280 • All rights reserved.
